items.text: Joseph M. Tracy is a retired State of Illinois employee who has lived in Palatine since 1992 and is the Republican candidate for the 54th District House seat. His campaign lists his priorities as lowering the tax burden, keeping communities safe, and defending local control.

sentences.text: Joseph M. Tracy is a retired State of Illinois employee who has lived in Palatine since 1992 and is the Republican candidate for the 54th District House seat.
His campaign lists his priorities as lowering the tax burden, keeping communities safe, and defending local control.

items.text: His campaign says he worked for three decades in state government, serving in both union and non-union roles, and earlier worked in the private and nonprofit sectors, including a role in adult health services.
